meta.scope: Philippines Batch 2 — Overseas Filipino Workers (OFW) and remittances densification, with explicit Canada linkage; supporting migration and bilateral nodes. Responds to user observation of large Filipino communities in Canada (Tagalog as second language in some Alberta cities).
meta.canada_note: Canada consistently ranks among the top cash-remittance source countries (recent BSP figures ~USD 1.2+ billion annually). Labour and migration cooperation is formalised in a 2026 Joint Declaration of Intent; trade and defence ties are deepening.

candidates.title: Overseas Filipino Workers stock and Survey on Overseas Filipinos
candidates.description: Official estimates of the number of Overseas Filipino Workers (recently ~2.19 million) and related characteristics from the Survey on Overseas Filipinos. Captures both land-based and sea-based workers and the gender composition (female majority in recent rounds).
candidates.notes: Core OFW stock node — one of the defining structural features of the Philippine economy and society.

candidates.title: Overseas Filipino cash remittances (total and by country)
candidates.description: High-frequency and annual statistics on cash remittances from overseas Filipinos, broken down by major source country. Remittances are a major stabilising component of the current account and household income.
candidates.notes: High-centrality external and household-income node. Canada is a consistently ranked source country.

candidates.title: Cash remittances from Canada
candidates.description: BSP-reported cash remittances originating from Canada. Recent annual figures exceed USD 1.2 billion, placing Canada among the top source countries alongside the United States, Middle East destinations, Singapore, Japan and others.
referenced_by: Canada–Philippines migration and labour cooperation nodes
candidates.notes: Explicit Canada–Philippines financial linkage node. Reflects the large Filipino diaspora in Canada (including communities where Tagalog ranks as a major non-official language).

candidates.title: Department of Migrant Workers institutional role and deployment statistics
candidates.description: Lead agency for overseas employment policy, contract processing and worker protection. Publishes deployment / contracts-processed statistics by destination, sex and type (land-based, sea-based, new hires, rehires).
candidates.notes: Policy and administrative counterpart to the statistical OFW nodes.

candidates.title: Philippines–Canada labour and migration cooperation framework
candidates.publisher: Department of Migrant Workers (PH) / Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada
candidates.description: Joint Declaration of Intent (signed Vancouver, July 2026) and related instruments on ethical recruitment, labour rights and migration cooperation. Formalises the policy channel that underpins the large bilateral labour flow.
candidates.notes: Key bilateral policy node linking the statistical remittance flow to formal labour-migration governance.

candidates.title: Canada–Philippines trade, defence and broader partnership framework
candidates.publisher: Governments of Canada and the Philippines
candidates.description: Evolving bilateral architecture including planned free-trade agreement, defence cooperation, energy and other sectoral understandings. Complements the labour-migration channel.
candidates.notes: Wider Canada partnership node beyond pure labour flows.

candidates.title: Family Income and Expenditure Survey (FIES)
candidates.description: Major household survey providing income, expenditure and inequality data. Primary source for official poverty statistics and for understanding the household-level impact of remittances.
candidates.notes: Household-income densification that links remittances to welfare outcomes.

candidates.title: Underemployment and quality-of-employment indicators (LFS)
candidates.description: Underemployment rates and related quality-of-employment measures from the Labor Force Survey. Complements the headline unemployment rate and is relevant to the push factors behind overseas work.
candidates.notes: Labour-quality node that helps explain the scale of the OFW phenomenon.

candidates.title: Philippines OFW–remittance–Canada densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from PSA, BSP, DMW and bilateral sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding OFW stock, total and Canada-specific remittances, DMW institutional role, Philippines–Canada labour/migration cooperation, broader Canada partnership, FIES household income/expenditure, and underemployment indicators into a coherent migration–remittance–Canada cluster.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
BOP, poverty and labour series from Batch 1
candidates.notes: High-centrality integrating node for the defining OFW/remittance feature and the Canada linkage requested by the user.
